posts.title: Mair Mototrip to Glen Coe
posts.description: This is the first major trip I've ever taken on this bike, and the second journey on a motorcycle ever over 100 miles (I once took my old Mutt Mongrel up to Ben Wyvis when I lived in bonny Inversnekie), and embarking on a one-day trip up to Glen Coe on any bike, yet alone my dinky 125cc Honda Grom was extremely daunting!
